commands.name: doctor handoff
commands.summary: Check whether work handed off from this terminal will actually be run by the Allnighter app. Drops one liveness ping in the hand-off mailbox; starts no worker and spends no quota. Distinguishes nothing-claimed-it from claimed-and-went-silent — never guesses.

commands.name: doctor silence

commands.name: capacity

args.name: run-id
args.summary: Optional run id; omit to sweep the caller's project scope.

flags.name: all-projects
flags.summary: Machine-wide fleet sweep instead of the caller's project scope.

commands.name: team reconcile
commands.summary: Explicit ownership reconcile: identity-dead async runs are reaped (PG-kill recorded pgid when present) and stamped endReason=reconciledOrphan. An exact run-id may target any project; the bare sweep is scoped to the caller's canonical project root (fail closed on unresolved roots) — machine-wide only via the explicit --all-projects.

flags.name: all
flags.summary: Include terminal/history rows (museum view). Default is alive + needs-action floor only.

flags.name: all-projects
flags.summary: Machine-wide fleet view instead of the caller's project scope.

commands.name: ps
commands.summary: List owned process trees (runs, loops, proofs). Reconciles identity-dead owners on read (CLP-S02) — no manual `team reconcile` on the happy path. PRIMARY liveness is stream silence (`run.lastActivityAt`), same as `alln loop status` — not relay heartbeat/pgid. Default shows alive + needs-action only; `--all` includes terminal history. Scoped to caller's project; `--all-projects` is machine-wide.

flags.name: all
flags.summary: Kill every identity-alive owned tree in the caller's project scope (skips identity-mismatched and already-terminal; unresolved roots are never swept).

flags.name: all-projects
flags.summary: With --all: machine-wide fleet kill instead of the caller's project scope.

commands.name: kill
commands.summary: Identity-checked total group kill of one owned tree (or --all identity-alive trees in the caller's project scope) and stamp endReason=killed. Refuses on identity mismatch (never signals a recycled pid). An exact id may target any project.

flags.name: dry-run
flags.summary: Report what would be pruned without deleting.

flags.name: json
flags.summary: Structured OwnershipGarbageCollectionJSON summary with every keep reason.

commands.name: gc
commands.summary: Prune old identity-dead terminal run/relay records beyond retention. Keeps identity-alive, non-terminal, recent, and thread-referenced records.

commands.antiExample: Do NOT use this to explore shapes — prefer `alln run --dry-run` or `alln menu --json` first; this spends quota.

flags.name: project
flags.summary: Project id, name, or repo path. When omitted, walk to the git root and match a registered project (AE-S05).

flags.name: team
flags.summary: Team preset id; omit for Default Team.

flags.name: seat
flags.summary: Override one crew seat model id (repeatable, crew order; requires --team; judgment teams only).

flags.name: lane
flags.summary: Lane tags the run for context and filtering; `--team` routes.

flags.name: idle-timeout
flags.summary: Override the worker idle-stall budget in seconds (default = driver manifest invoke.timeoutSeconds, commonly 1800s for agent CLIs). Resets on streaming stdout/stderr bytes, attributable process-group activity (child spawn, CPU under the recorded pgid), and durable recordProgress heartbeats; wall is the hard ceiling (--wall-timeout, default 3600).

flags.name: handshake-timeout
flags.summary: Runner-ready handshake bound in seconds (default 60; RLR-L8). Finite positive required.

flags.name: first-activity-timeout
flags.summary: First post-spawn activity bound in seconds (default 120; RLR-L8). Finite positive required.

flags.name: wall-timeout
flags.summary: Total wall-clock ceiling in seconds (default 3600; RLR-L8). Finite positive required.

flags.name: idempotency-key
flags.summary: Transport idempotency key (24h replay window). Same key+payload replays the original run; conflict/expired refuse.

flags.name: retry-of
flags.summary: Intentional retry of a prior run id (new key). Requires prior tree verified stopped, or --accept-survivors.

flags.name: accept-survivors
flags.summary: Allow --retry-of when the prior run still has identity-alive recorded workers.

flags.name: commit-message
flags.summary: Exact commit message for the worker (FR12 instruct + verify; Allnighter does no git).

flags.name: no-commit
flags.summary: Instruct the worker to leave work uncommitted for PM review (mutually exclusive with --commit-message). Still mutating and still takes the per-root write lock — does not skip the queue. For parallel feedback use --read-only --model.

flags.name: read-only
flags.summary: Lock policy only: same one-model chat as --model, with writePolicy readOnly and no write-lock queue. Requires --model. Not a team path; not FS isolation. Mutually exclusive with --team and mutator-only flags (--no-commit, --commit-message, --try-fix, --proof).

flags.name: proof
flags.summary: Run a bounded proof command after the worker settles; surface pass/fail (never blocks git).

flags.name: try-fix
flags.summary: Bug Hunt diagnosis → danger-not-doubt gate → one bounded fix attempt.

flags.name: agent
flags.summary: Origin agent id for attribution (does not select the worker).

flags.name: dry-run
flags.summary: Resolve project/worker/auth/writePolicy/effects/write-lock and return canStart + counts; exit 0, no dispatch. Research Teams are observational in the canonical repository; terminal repoDelta reports whether a mutating run wrote.

flags.name: json
flags.summary: Emit TeamRunJSON (blocking run), RunDryRunJSON v2 with --dry-run, or a detached acknowledgement with one nextAction.command (`alln show <id> --stream`) with --no-wait.

flags.name: stream
flags.summary: Emit NDJSON events (one JSON object per stdout line; ends with teamRunCompleted, teamRunFailed, or error). Shared framing: immediate snapshot first, bounded replay, live follow of new events, exactly one terminal frame. Ends at terminal or attention-required boundary; terminal exit class propagates unconditionally (no opt-in). Mutually exclusive with conflicting mode flags.

flags.name: no-wait
flags.summary: Hand the run to a detached child of the same registered `alln run` verb; return only after the child durably accepts with one nextAction.command = `alln show <id> --stream` (real run id, including idempotency replay). A child refusal fails loud. Mutually exclusive with --stream / --dry-run / --try-fix.

flags.name: delivery
flags.summary: Detached delivery path. Only `wake` is supported and requires machine-level pmTurnWake.command.

commands.name: run
commands.summary: Unified run: message + optional Team + agent in the registered repository root. Research Teams are observational and execution Teams use one selected agent. TeamRunJSON reports agent terminal states and Git observation, never a correctness verdict.
commands.trigger: Use when the user wants one agent or team to answer or act in a project repo root (chat / named-model ask / Default Team / --no-wait to keep going after you step away).

commands.name: run resume
commands.summary: Resume a run parked on vendor capacity (same run id, in-process).

commands.name: continuity receipt
commands.summary: Local observed-facts summary of vendor waits covered and automatic resumes (last 24h).

args.name: brief
args.summary: What you want done. The brief handed to the PM at round 1 — no other flag is required.

commands.example: alln loop start "execute this doc" --spec docs/phases/Loop_Verb_Cutover.md --pm caller --dev model_grok

flags.name: spec
flags.summary: Repo-relative spec doc path — a shortcut for when the brief would be three paragraphs, not the shape. The PM re-reads it fresh each round.

flags.name: pm
flags.summary: PM occupant: `caller` (this session reviews every round) or a canonical agent id (that agent is spawned as PM and the loop runs unattended). Omitted → the Frontier-tier default.

flags.name: dev
flags.summary: Dev seat canonical agent id. Omitted → the Balanced-tier default.

flags.name: project
flags.summary: Project id, name, or repo path. Omitted → resolved from the current working directory.

flags.name: dry-run
flags.summary: Resolve the brief/spec/both seats/project and report readiness; exit 0, create nothing, spend nothing.

flags.name: no-wait
flags.summary: Spawn the same registered `loop start` verb in a detached child; return only after the child durably claims delivery.

flags.name: json
flags.summary: Emit structured JSON (LoopStartDryRunJSON with --dry-run; LoopJSON otherwise).

commands.name: loop start
commands.summary: Start a durable PM↔dev loop. The brief is the only required input — both seats default by tier. `--pm caller` reviews every round yourself; `--pm <agent-id>` (or the default) spawns that agent as PM and runs unattended.
commands.trigger: Use when the user wants a multi-round PM↔dev loop that reviews real commits round after round until the work is done — with or without naming who sits in which chair.

flags.name: project
flags.summary: Project id, name, or repo path. Omitted → resolved from the current working directory.

commands.name: loop list
commands.summary: List durable PM↔dev loops for the resolved project (id, status, brief/spec, seats, updatedAt).

flags.name: wait-for
flags.summary: Wait for parked (awaitingPM|escalated) or terminal (done|stopped); requires --timeout.

flags.name: timeout
flags.summary: Non-negative wait limit in seconds; required with --wait-for.

flags.name: json
flags.summary: Emit LoopJSON (plus additive live usage fields while running).

commands.name: loop status

flags.name: json

flags.summary: Emit NDJSON RelayProgressJSON events, then a final PilotHandoffJSON envelope (or, with --no-wait, a single delivery acknowledgement).

commands.name: pair pilot handoff
commands.summary: Retired — use `alln loop step <loop-id>` instead. Submits this round's review (LoopVerdict tail or --verdict + handover file); blocks through the dev turn by default and prints the dev's report verbatim. Long jobs: prefer --no-wait, then run its returned parked status waiter once.

flags.name: wait-for
flags.summary: Wait for parked (awaitingPM|escalated); requires --timeout. terminal is not valid for Pilot.

flags.name: timeout
flags.summary: Non-negative wait limit in seconds; required with --wait-for.

flags.name: json
flags.summary: Emit PilotStatusJSON (relay + recovery nextActions; while running adds elapsedSeconds, ownerAlive, lastProgressAt/silenceAgeSeconds as primary stream liveness, streamSilenceWarning when silence > 6×waitHint, commitsSinceBaseline as supplementary/not liveness, waitHintSeconds 45, watcherDisposable).

commands.name: pair pilot status
commands.summary: Retired — use `alln loop status <loop-id>` instead. Reads a caller-held loop's durable state, or waits for its parked PM boundary (awaitingPM|escalated). While running: elapsedSeconds, ownerAlive, lastProgressAt/silenceAgeSeconds (PRIMARY stream liveness — same truth as alln ps; not relay heartbeat/pgid), streamSilenceWarning when silence > 6×waitHint, commitsSinceBaseline (SUPPLEMENTARY only — not liveness), waitHintSeconds 45, watcherDisposable. Prefer over wait for agents.

flags.name: max-wait
flags.summary: Stop waiting after N seconds while still running; exit with stillRunning and reattach to pilot status (default 1800 when stdout is not a TTY; interactive TTY waits until settled unless set).

flags.name: json
flags.summary: Emit PilotWatchJSON (final single-line envelope; NDJSON pilotWatchHeartbeat lines while waiting).

commands.name: pair pilot watch
commands.summary: Retired — use `alln loop wait <loop-id>` instead. Optional interactive waiter: blocks until the in-flight round settles. Disposable — death ≠ job failure; prefer `loop status` for agents. Emits heartbeats while running; SIGTERM/SIGINT prints stillRunning goodbye.

commands.name: pair pilot adopt
commands.summary: Retired — use `alln loop pm <loop-id> caller` instead. Hands a parked spawned loop's PM seat to the caller session (status → awaitingPM). No dispatch.

commands.name: pair pilot scaffold-handover
commands.summary: Retired alongside `pair pilot`. Writes or re-emits a suggested PM handover markdown template for a loop round; the underlying auto-seed template is unaffected.

flags.name: full
flags.summary: Include resolved worker prompt snapshots (audit). Mutually exclusive with --stream.

flags.name: stream
flags.summary: Emit NDJSON events (one JSON object per stdout line; ends with teamRunCompleted, teamRunFailed, or error). Shared framing: immediate snapshot first, bounded replay, live follow of new events, exactly one terminal frame. Ends at terminal or attention-required boundary; terminal exit class propagates unconditionally (no opt-in). Mutually exclusive with conflicting mode flags.

commands.name: show
commands.summary: Show one run. Snapshot (`--json`) or reattachable stream (`--stream`): immediate snapshot, bounded replay, live follow, exactly one terminal; terminal exit class propagates unconditionally.

commands.name: floor show
commands.summary: Show the inspectable Floor for one team run (worker lanes, artifacts, typed return, timeline, Execute requirements). For the polished HTML receipt, use `alln artifact show <id>`.

commands.antiExample: Do NOT use this while a run is still running — it fails closed with RUN_NOT_TERMINAL. Do NOT confuse with `alln floor show`, `alln export`, or `alln continuity receipt`.

flags.summary: Print the absolute path only; do not open the default browser.

flags.name: json
flags.summary: Emit path, run id, and honesty string only (no HTML body).

commands.summary: Regenerate and open the private HTML team artifact for a terminal run.
commands.trigger: After a terminal team run, open the polished private receipt (not the Factory Floor).

commands.antiExample: Do NOT use this for markdown export — use `alln export --format md`. Do NOT use while a run is still running.

flags.name: out
flags.summary: Destination file path for the HTML export (required).

flags.name: json
flags.summary: Emit path, run id, and honesty string only (no HTML body).

commands.summary: Export the styled HTML team artifact to a user-chosen path for offline reading.

commands.name: serve
commands.summary: Optional background scheduler (Pending wake, Boost seeding, vendor-backoff continuation, cloud relay) — and posts local notifications when a run, team run, or Delivery Loop round lands or needs an answer. It owns no run semantics: `alln run` never needs it. Start it in a terminal; Ctrl+C stops it. `alln loop step`/`start`/`resume`/`pm` auto-start it in the background unless `--no-auto-serve`/`ALLN_NO_AUTO_SERVE` is set.

errors.agentAction: Re-run `alln docs <command>` and fix arguments.
errors.explain: The command was called with invalid or conflicting arguments. Consult the generated docs for the command and correct the invocation.

errors.agentAction: Re-run `alln <command> --help` or `alln docs <command>`; fix or remove the unknown flag.
errors.explain: The invocation included a flag not declared for this command. Near-matches are listed in the error message. Unknown flags never no-op — a misspelled safety flag must not dispatch a real run.

errors.agentAction: Retry with `alln install-cli --path ~/.local/bin` or choose a writable directory.
errors.explain: The install-cli target directory is missing or not writable. Use --path to a writable directory (e.g. ~/.local/bin) or fix permissions on /usr/local/bin.

errors.agentAction: Inspect the migration error, back up ~/Library/Application Support/Allnighter if needed, then retry.
errors.explain: The one-time retired worker-key migration under the support root failed. Fix the reported filesystem/JSON issue before continuing.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln dev export-contracts`, then rebuild.
errors.explain: Generated artifacts no longer match the registry. Regenerate and rebuild before relying on output.

errors.agentAction: Bump `ContractRegistry.contractVersion` (minor for additions, major for removals/renames), then run `alln dev export-contracts`.
errors.explain: The agent-facing contract surface hash changed but contractVersion was not bumped. Surface edits cannot ship without an explicit compatibility bump (AE-S11).

errors.agentAction: Run `alln dev export-contracts` from inside the repo (repo root or a subdirectory).
errors.explain: The repo root, the generated artifacts dir, or an individual artifact file could not be found. This is not content drift — it means the artifacts were never generated at the resolved location, or the command ran outside the repo.

errors.agentAction: Use one of frontier | balanced | economy.
errors.explain: The tier name was not frontier, balanced, or economy. Legacy names flagship and fast still parse but are retired.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln models --json` and pass a known model id.
errors.explain: The model id is not in the catalog, so it cannot be assigned to a tier. List models and use a real id.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln stalled list --all --json` and use a current episode id.
errors.explain: No stall episode matches the given id (it may have cleared). List stalled work and retry with a live episode id.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln doctor --json`.
errors.explain: A required doctor check failed. Inspect the structured report and address the named check, then retry.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln doctor --json`; add/configure the missing source.
errors.explain: A required source CLI/runtime was not resolved on this machine. Install or locate it, then re-probe.

errors.agentAction: Re-authenticate the named source.
errors.explain: The source resolved but its authentication is invalid or expired. Sign in via the source's own login flow.

errors.agentAction: Open the provider app once, run its login command in Terminal, then `alln doctor --full --agent <source>`.
errors.explain: The source CLI could not read credentials from the macOS Keychain (SecItemCopyMatching failed). Common when Allnighter or the CLI is launched outside Terminal. Open the provider app, complete sign-in, then re-probe.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln models --json`; pick an on-Bench ready model or enable one.
errors.explain: The requested model is not runnable: it may be off-Bench, its source may not be ready, or it may not exist. Use `alln models --json` to see available vs on-Bench vs ready state.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln menu --json` (or `alln menu show model:<id>`); pass a canonical model_* id. Never substitute a display name.
errors.explain: An explicit `--model` / `--dev-model` request named a model that is disabled, notReady, unknown, or a display name. Allnighter never silently substitutes a different model behind an explicit worker id (Process_Ownership.md PO-F10 / Menu_Not_Router MR-S04).

errors.agentAction: Run `alln menu --json` / `alln teams show <id> --json`; fix unavailable workers.
errors.explain: The default team has no runnable workers. Inspect and repair the team lineup before running.

errors.agentAction: Inspect `agentId` and source error; failed agent remains visible.
errors.explain: One agent failed. The failure is shown, never hidden; other agents may still have answered. Retry the agent or proceed with partial results.

errors.agentAction: Retry with a ready plan writer or export worker answers.
errors.explain: The plan-writer stage failed. Retry with a ready plan writer, or export the worker answers and synthesize later.

errors.agentAction: Retry with lower effort or fewer workers.
errors.explain: The team run exceeded its time budget. Reduce effort or the worker count and retry.

errors.agentAction: Re-run the same `pilot status` or `relay-status` waiter with a longer --timeout; do not switch to a polling loop or resume command.
errors.explain: The relay PM boundary did not reach the requested target before --timeout. The status response carries waitOutcome: timedOut.

errors.agentAction: Configure machine-level pmTurnWake.command, then retry `--no-wait --delivery wake`; or omit --delivery and run the returned status waiter.
errors.explain: Wake delivery was requested, but this Mac has no PM Turn receiver command configured. Nothing was dispatched.

errors.agentAction: Read status JSON for pmTurnDelivery, fix the receiver, then use the terminal/parked status waiter to recover the durable pmTurn.
errors.explain: The configured PM Turn receiver did not acknowledge the durable turn before its retry window ended. The PM turn remains on disk and status projects the failure.

errors.agentAction: Alias of PM_TURN_WAIT_TIMEOUT: re-run the same waiter with a longer --timeout.
errors.explain: Compatibility alias for PM_TURN_WAIT_TIMEOUT.

errors.agentAction: Inspect failed workers and stages; retry or adjust the team.
errors.explain: The team run ended without a usable result (e.g. failed or cancelled). Inspect the failed workers/stages in the run, then retry or change the team.

errors.agentAction: Do not recursively spawn teams without explicit depth budget.
errors.explain: A worker tried to start another team run beyond the allowed depth. Set an explicit depth budget if nesting is intended.

errors.agentAction: Wait or retry after current team run completes.
errors.explain: The concurrency governor is at capacity. Wait for a slot and retry; this is a real busy state, not a fake queue.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln doctor --json`; ensure Allnighter's support directory is writable, or set a writable support root for eval runs.
errors.explain: The team-run governor could not create, open, or lock its slot store. This is a storage/permission/configuration problem, not a capacity limit.

errors.agentAction: Keep item Draft/Pending; mutating pending runs are outside Pending M1.
errors.explain: Mutating pending runs are not enabled in this milestone. Keep the item Draft/Pending.

errors.agentAction: Keep order unchanged; reorder only Pending items in the same serialized group.
errors.explain: The requested Pending reorder was rejected because the item and anchor do not share the same serialized group.

errors.agentAction: Generate a new key or reuse the original payload.
errors.explain: The same idempotency key was reused with a different canonical payload. Use a new key or repeat the original request. (Public RLR-L9 name; alias of legacy IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_PAYLOAD.)

errors.agentAction: Generate a new key or reuse the original payload.
errors.explain: Legacy alias of IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT — same key reused with a different canonical payload.

errors.agentAction: Generate a new idempotency key.
errors.explain: The idempotency key's 24h replay window has elapsed. The key is a tombstone — never silently re-execute; mint a new key.

errors.agentAction: Wait for verified stop, or pass --accept-survivors.
errors.explain: `--retry-of` refused because the prior run still has identity-alive recorded workers. Pass --accept-survivors to proceed anyway.

errors.agentAction: Re-run `alln run resume <runId>` once the host is running again, or read the partial record with `alln show <runId> --json`.
errors.explain: The run has not finished and this process stopped waiting for it. Either nothing claimed the hand-off (open Allnighter) or the host that claimed it stopped without finishing. The run id stays valid; the answer is collectable if a host completes it.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln history --json`.
errors.explain: No run matches the given id. List history and pick a valid run id or `latest`.

errors.agentAction: Confirm the run is parked (`waitingForVendor`) via `alln show <runId> --json`, then retry `alln run resume <runId>`.
errors.explain: Vendor-wake resume could not claim the run — it is not parked waiting for a vendor, or another coordinator already holds the wake lease.

errors.agentAction: Check the support dir is writable (disk space / permissions), then retry the run.
errors.explain: An authoritative run journal write failed. At mint time (RLR-L2) this refuses to hand back an id without a durable, pollable journal, so no run was started. At terminal settlement (CR-S02) the worker may have run, but its result could not be durably persisted — the run is reported as failed rather than returning success over a lost journal. Either way the durable record is unavailable; check disk space / permissions on the support dir and retry.

errors.agentAction: Do not retry the same run id; confirm via `alln show <id> --json` (typed error), then start a new run if the work still matters. Never inspect private journal paths by hand — a corrupt journal is never silently treated as not-found or coerced to an invented status.
errors.explain: A durable journal exists for the id but failed to decode (e.g. an unknown/legacy status raw value). Distinct from RUN_NOT_FOUND, which means no journal was ever found at all (RLR-L8).

errors.agentAction: Fix the local run journal/storage failure, then rerun the foreground command.
errors.explain: A stream event could not be durably stamped, so Allnighter stopped the stream rather than emitting an unjournaled event.

errors.agentAction: Reuse the original payload for this idempotency key, or submit a new key for new work.
errors.explain: A request reused an idempotency key with a different semantic payload.

errors.agentAction: Retry the same idempotency key and payload; do not create a second direct run.
errors.explain: The client did not observe a durable resident acceptance receipt before its timeout.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln skills --lane <lane> --json` and pick a valid skill id.
errors.explain: No skill matches the given id. List skills for the lane and retry with a valid SkillID.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln menu --json` (or `alln menu show team:<id>`) and retry with a canonical team id — never a display name.
errors.explain: No team matches the given id (or a display name was passed). List the live menu and retry with a valid TeamID.

errors.agentAction: Edit the team with `teams edit` instead; only delete an edited built-in (which restores the shipped version).
errors.explain: A built-in team that was never edited has nothing to delete. Edit it in place with `teams edit`, or use `teams restore` to revert prior edits.

errors.agentAction: Only built-in teams can be restored; for a custom team, edit or delete it instead.
errors.explain: Restore reverts a built-in team to its shipped version. A custom team has no shipped version to restore to.

errors.agentAction: Built-in skills cannot be deleted. Use `skills restore` to drop an override, or `skills duplicate` for a separate copy.
errors.explain: Built-in skill seeds cannot be deleted. Restore removes a same-ID override; duplicate mints a new custom id.

errors.agentAction: Only built-in skills can be restored; for a custom skill, edit or delete it instead.
errors.explain: Restore reverts a built-in skill to its shipped seed. A custom skill has no shipped version to restore to.

errors.agentAction: Pick a different team id or delete the conflicting custom team.
errors.explain: A team with this id already exists.

errors.agentAction: Pick a different skill id or delete the conflicting custom skill.
errors.explain: A skill with this id already exists.

errors.agentAction: Fix the team definition and retry `alln teams edit`.
errors.explain: The team definition is invalid (missing rows, unknown skills, or bad effort/output kind).

errors.agentAction: Fix the skill definition and retry `alln skills edit`.
errors.explain: The skill definition is invalid (empty template, missing lane, or unknown purpose).

errors.agentAction: Set another default team before deleting or changing the lane default.
errors.explain: The default-team change would leave a lane without a valid default.

errors.agentAction: Remove the skill from team definitions before deleting.
errors.explain: The skill is still referenced by one or more team definitions.

errors.agentAction: Pick a skill from the same lane as the team.
errors.explain: A team row references a skill from another lane.

errors.agentAction: Use a canonical lowercase id matching the catalog rules.
errors.explain: The catalog id fails canonical ID rules.

errors.agentAction: Treat as implementation bug; run export-contracts check.
errors.explain: Output failed to match its declared schema. This is an implementation bug; run the export-contracts drift check.

errors.agentAction: Ask the user for the named permission.
errors.explain: The action needs a user-granted permission that is not present. Request the named permission before retrying.

errors.agentAction: Re-ingest or re-send the attachment; do not retry with stale bytes.
errors.explain: Attachment storedSha256 does not match on-disk bytes.

errors.agentAction: Use thread_get to list resolved attachments for the turn.
errors.explain: No attachment record exists for the requested id.

errors.agentAction: Remove attachments until within the count cap.
errors.explain: Too many images attached for one send.

errors.agentAction: Use a smaller image or fewer attachments.
errors.explain: An attachment exceeds byte or megapixel limits.

errors.agentAction: Send PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP only.
errors.explain: Attachment MIME type is not allowed.

errors.agentAction: Fix or replace the corrupt image file.
errors.explain: Image could not be decoded.

errors.agentAction: Fix the base64 payload.
errors.explain: Base64 image payload is invalid.

errors.agentAction: Check workingDir permissions and disk space.
errors.explain: Could not copy attachment into workspace mirror.

errors.agentAction: Add `.allnighter/` to gitignore or info/exclude manually.
errors.explain: Staged mirror but could not update git ignore rules.

errors.agentAction: Reduce message or attachment count; never silently trim current send.
errors.explain: Protected attachment block does not fit context cap.

errors.agentAction: Bind the thread to a project/working directory, then retry.
errors.explain: File references resolve against the Mac project root. The thread has no usable root.

errors.agentAction: Pick a path inside the project root.
errors.explain: The requested path escapes the enrolled project root, so Allnighter refused to read it.

errors.agentAction: Refresh the file picker or choose an existing project file.
errors.explain: The referenced file no longer exists at run time.

errors.agentAction: Check file permissions or choose another file.
errors.explain: The file exists but Allnighter could not read it as a regular file.

errors.agentAction: Reference text files only in v1.
errors.explain: File references v1 injects UTF-8 text. Binary files are not delivered.

errors.agentAction: Reference a smaller file or a line range.
errors.explain: The source file exceeds the v1 per-file read cap.

errors.agentAction: Remove file references until within the cap.
errors.explain: The send has more file references than v1 allows.

errors.agentAction: Do not attach secrets; summarize the needed config manually.
errors.explain: The path looks like credentials, keys, or an environment file and was blocked.

errors.agentAction: Choose a valid 1-based line range inside the file.
errors.explain: The requested line range is empty, reversed, or past the end of the file.

errors.agentAction: Refresh the reference and re-approve the changed file before running.
errors.explain: A delayed or pending send would read different bytes than the approved reference hash.

errors.agentAction: Refresh the Project file picker and retry.
errors.explain: The search catalog was stale. The resolver remains authoritative and did not deliver stale content.

errors.agentAction: Choose a worker that can receive referenced file text or use a chat worker.
errors.explain: The selected route cannot accept Project file references.

errors.agentAction: Use a new idempotency key or repeat the original payload.
errors.explain: Same idempotency key reused with a different thread send payload.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln history --json` (or create a thread); retry with a valid thread id.
errors.explain: No thread matches the given id, or no threads exist yet. List threads and retry with a valid thread id.

errors.agentAction: Re-run the Bug Hunt diagnosis; the fix attempt needs a typed fix packet.
errors.explain: The Bug Hunt answer run produced no typed fix packet (the writer emitted no fenced fix-packet block), so there is no hypothesis to try. Re-run the diagnosis with a sharper report.

errors.agentAction: Read the gate reason; resolve the danger flag / add an actionable hypothesis + proof, then retry.
errors.explain: The fix packet is not safe to execute: it carries a danger flag (credentials, deletion, deploy…), lacks an actionable hypothesis (a fix within a boundary), names no truth owner, or its proof method is incomplete. Danger blocks; doubt does not.

errors.agentAction: Pass --executor a single mutating team that is runnable on this bench (default build_slice).
errors.explain: The chosen fix executor is not a single, mutating, runnable team. The fix attempt must resolve to exactly one mutating worker.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln loop status <id> --json` with a valid loop id, or start a new loop with `alln loop start "<what you want done>"`.
errors.explain: No PM Relay matches the given id.

errors.agentAction: The relay folder exists but relay.json cannot be read by this binary — rebuild from the current branch (`swift build --package-path Packages/AllnighterCore` + `alln install-cli`). If the file uses retired devWorkerId/pmWorkerId keys, delete the relay folder or rewrite seat keys to devModelId/pmModelId.
errors.explain: A relay.json is present on disk but failed to decode — not the same as a missing id. Common during dogfood when a stale on-PATH alln binary predates the WTA seat-key rename.

errors.agentAction: Check status with `alln loop status <id>`; only resume/pm-eligible statuses accept those transitions. Founder stop uses `alln loop stop` and does not use this code.
errors.explain: The requested resume/pm-reassignment transition is not valid for the loop's current status — not a founder-stop error.

errors.agentAction: The PM's handover named a danger instruction (credentials, signing, destructive git, sandbox/TCC, mass deletion); the relay escalated instead of dispatching it. Answer the escalation or rewrite the round's intent.
errors.explain: HandoverGate blocked a PM handover before it reached the dev seat — danger blocks, doubt does not.

errors.agentAction: Read it with `alln loop status <id> --json`, resume it or reassign the PM with `alln loop pm`, or wait — do not start a second loop on the same doc.
errors.explain: a loop is already running for this project + doc

errors.agentAction: The relay claim could not be written durably — check disk space and permissions under the support root, then retry the relay verb.
errors.explain: Relay dispatch could not persist its claim to the journal.

errors.agentAction: Wait with `alln loop status <id> --wait-for parked --timeout 7200 --json`; do not re-dispatch while running. A killed `alln loop wait` is not a failed round. Once parked, retry `alln loop step` if still needed.
errors.explain: A loop round is already dispatching (status == running) — one mutating dev turn at a time, unchanged law. A concurrent dispatch (step, or a resume/pm-reassignment racing another) on the same loop is refused rather than racing a second dev turn onto one repo root. Founder stop never uses this code.

errors.agentAction: Inspect with `alln ps --json`; retry `alln loop stop <id> --json`. Do not invent resume while live trees remain.
errors.explain: Founder stop could not honestly settle: a signalled owner or turn tree is still identity-alive. Status is left non-terminal rather than stamping stopped over known-live work.

errors.agentAction: Attach with `alln run resume <id> --json`, or omit an explicit id.
errors.explain: a run already exists with this id

errors.agentAction: Run `alln loop status <id> --json`; a loop only accepts `alln loop step` while its status is `awaitingPM` (done/escalated/stopped have nothing left to hand off to).
errors.explain: `loop step` was called against a loop that isn't parked at `awaitingPM` — it already reached a terminal status, or isn't a caller-held loop's normal between-rounds state.

errors.agentAction: The PM's submission needs exactly one trailing ```json LoopVerdict block (verdict: continue|done|escalate; handover required for continue). Fix the tail and resubmit `alln loop step` — the loop is still `awaitingPM`, no re-ask machinery runs.
errors.explain: A `loop step` submission didn't end with a parseable LoopVerdict tail (missing entirely, an unknown verdict value, or `continue` with no handover). Unlike a spawned PM turn, there is no automatic re-ask — the caller session is live and just resubmits.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln ps --json` and pick a current owned id, or omit and use `alln kill --all` for every identity-alive tree.
errors.explain: No owned process tree matches the given id in durable state (run dirs, relay dirs, lane holders).

errors.agentAction: No action required; the tree already carries a stamped endReason. Inspect with `alln ps --json`.
errors.explain: `alln kill` refused because the named work is already terminal — kill never clobbers an existing terminal endReason.

errors.agentAction: Do not retry the same kill against this pid; the recorded identity no longer matches the live process (pid reuse). Run `alln ps --json` and `alln team reconcile` for identity-dead orphans instead.
errors.explain: Kill refused: the recorded owner identity has a live pid whose start time does not match (recycled pid). Signalling would hit the wrong process.

errors.agentAction: The run stays non-terminal with survivors named. Inspect them with `alln ps --json`, then retry `alln kill <id>` or escalate manually; the tool refuses to stamp `killed` over live work.
errors.explain: `alln kill`/`team cancel` signalled the recorded tree but ≥1 recorded member is still identity-alive (or its group non-empty) after the grace. The verdict is `killOutcome: partial` — the lifecycle is left non-terminal (RLR-L5), never a false `killed` stamp.

errors.agentAction: No recorded member could be signalled (all identity-mismatched or non-PG-killable). Run `alln ps --json` and `alln team reconcile` for identity-dead orphans; do not re-signal a recycled pid.
errors.explain: `alln kill`/`team cancel` found recorded members but could signal none of them — every candidate was a recycled pid or a non-group-killable owner. Nothing was stopped; the verdict is `killOutcome: refused` and the lifecycle stays non-terminal.

errors.agentAction: The run records no killable worker `runtimeOwnership` (warm workers or unrecorded legacy). The stop cannot be verified — read `alln show <run-id> --json` or stop the worker at its source; the tool will not stamp `killed` unverified.
errors.explain: The executing run carries no recorded worker identity to verify against (the warm-driver exclusion seam — warm pools record nothing). `killOutcome: verificationUnavailable`: a stop cannot be proven, so no terminal `killed` is stamped (RLR-L5).

errors.agentAction: Inspect the error detail; retry the send or fix the worker.
errors.explain: The thread send did not complete (worker or transport failure). Inspect the detail, then retry.

errors.agentAction: List ids with `alln menu --json` or `alln models --json` and retry with a valid ModelID.
errors.explain: No model matches the given id. Use `alln menu --json` / `alln models --json` for catalog ModelIDs.

errors.agentAction: Duplicate the built-in model, then edit the custom copy.
errors.explain: Built-in models cannot be edited or deleted. Duplicate to a custom model and edit that copy.

errors.agentAction: Pick a different model id or delete the conflicting custom model.
errors.explain: A model with this id already exists.

errors.agentAction: Fix the model definition and retry the edit.
errors.explain: The model definition or id is invalid (bad id, missing fields, or unknown driver mapping).

errors.agentAction: Reference a known driver id, or add the driver manifest first.
errors.explain: The model references a driver that is not registered. Use a known driver id or add its manifest.

errors.agentAction: Capture the message and `traceId`; retry once, then report if it persists.
errors.explain: An unexpected internal failure occurred (not a usage error). The detail is in the message; this is a defensive catch-all, not a routine condition.

errors.agentAction: If cwd is an unregistered git root, run `alln project add <path>`. Otherwise `alln project list --json` and retry with a valid id or path.
errors.explain: No project matches the given id/path, or cwd's git root is not registered. Add the project or pick a valid identifier.

errors.agentAction: Select or add a project, then re-run the mutating action.
errors.explain: A mutating action was attempted with no project selected. Mutating work is always scoped to one project root.

errors.agentAction: Use the existing project that owns this normalized root.
errors.explain: The path resolves to an existing project's normalized root; the existing project is returned rather than a duplicate.

errors.agentAction: Restore the folder/permissions, then `alln project show <id>` to re-observe.
errors.explain: The project root is missing or permission-denied (rootState != available); mutating runs are blocked until the root is restored.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln project unarchive <id>` before new runs.
errors.explain: The project is archived. Unarchive it before starting new runs; reads remain available.

errors.agentAction: Assign the thread/pending item to a project, then retry.
errors.explain: The thread or pending item has no project. Assign it to a project before a mutating run.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln project models <id> --json`; open the CLI in the project folder and complete its trust/login, then recheck.
errors.explain: The target worker's project readiness is not `ready` for this root. The run waits until the worker is ready here.

errors.agentAction: The active mutating run on this repo root looks stuck (the wait bound elapsed); wait for it to finish or stop it, then retry.
errors.explain: At most one mutating run per canonical repo root. A second mutating run normally QUEUES (FIFO) behind the active one and runs when it finishes; this error is the safety valve — it fires only when the active run is still holding the lock after the wait bound (it is wedged), so the queued run is refused instead of hanging forever.

errors.agentAction: Do not busy-loop or invent a private retry cadence. The harness owns the wait: poll relay/pilot status for laneBlocked (position, holder identity/kind/id, heldSinceSeconds) until the ticket clears, or let the harness grant the lane. Never start a second concurrent build-class turn on the same root.
errors.explain: The per-root execution lane is held. Busy callers receive a FIFO ticket naming position and holder; silent queueing without a ticket is forbidden (Process_Ownership.md PO-S03).

errors.agentAction: Inspect roundLog.scopeViolation (declared writeScope + outOfScopePaths). The harness rejected the turn's work fail-closed; endReason stays reported. Do not auto-revert — the PM decides whether to keep, amend, or reverse the commits. Next turn: stay inside the declared prefixes or re-declare a broader writeScope.
errors.explain: A dev turn declared writeScope path prefixes and the harness found commits (baseline..head) outside that scope. Work is rejected with scopeViolation on roundLog/status; Allnighter never touches git (Process_Ownership.md PO-S06).

errors.agentAction: Inspect roundLog.standingFailed and proofResults entries with standing:true. For contractDrift: rebuild the turn tree, run `alln dev export-contracts` (regenerate docs/generated/alln/*), commit the artifacts, and re-run. The harness never auto-regenerates or auto-commits (Process_Ownership.md PO-F4).
errors.explain: A harness standing invariant failed after the dev turn (e.g. contractDrift: registry changed without regenerating published contract artifacts). The turn is not clean; endReason stays reported; standingFailed names the invariant ids.

errors.agentAction: Restore the project folder or pick an available project root, then retry.
errors.explain: The project repo root is missing or unreadable; runs require a real cwd in the repo.

errors.agentAction: Pick a ready worker or run setup health, then retry.
errors.explain: No runnable worker resolved for this run (missing CLI, wrong driver, or bench not ready).

errors.agentAction: Pick one execution source, run as non-mutating review/propose, or split into judgment then execution.
errors.explain: Mutating execution teams must resolve to one CLI driver. Mixed-source execution is blocked before spawn.

errors.agentAction: Run `alln models --json`; use a known driver id in appliesTo.
errors.explain: The utilization source id is not registered on this bench.

errors.agentAction: Add the source to Boost window appliesTo, then retry.
errors.explain: The source is not included in the Boost window appliesTo list.

errors.agentAction: Sign in to the named CLI, then retry the seed.
errors.explain: The seed stopped on an auth prompt. Allnighter never auto-confirms sign-in.

errors.agentAction: Resolve billing on the provider, then retry.
errors.explain: The seed stopped on a billing or quota prompt. Allnighter never auto-confirms payment.
